deploy-bot: [release] progressive rollout started: inference-api v2.4.0 -> 10% traffic, staged schedule 22:00-23:00 UTC. Rollout ID r-20260323-01
Anna S: Quick check — release notes link?
Mike R: grabbing telemetry, seeing a p95 bump in eu-west-1 (+280ms) and a tiny uptick in 502s. Not sure if correlated with rollout yet.
Jen P: Can we hold ramp and cut traffic back to 5% while we investigate? :eyes: 
deploy-bot: Action: pause_ramp r-20260323-01 -> paused at 10% by request of Jen P. To resume: /deploy resume r-20260323-01
Anna S: Thanks. Can someone pin the previous stable v2.3.9 in eu-west until root cause?
Leo T: I can pin and roll back if needed. Running quick sample query set now.
Mike R: attaching quick logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-23T22:07:12Z] inference-api eu-west-1 502 error GET /v1/generate id=abc123 latency=0.86s
[2026-03-23T22:07:14Z] inference-api eu-west-1 200 id=def456 latency=0.12s
```
Jen P: If we confirm regression, let's roll back traffic in eu-west only. Prefer soft rollback -> v2.3.9 for region.
deploy-bot: Suggested command to regional rollback:
```
releasectl region-rollback --service inference-api --region eu-west-1 --to v2.3.9 --drain 30s
```
Anna S: Agreed. Mike, capture sample (50 requests) with failing header X-Trace and upload to #eng-ml-evals.
Mike R: on it, uploading in ~5m. Will also open a short incident if >1% error rate.
Jen P: tagging @sre for infra knobs. @Leo T please coordinate pin/rollback after Mike confirms.
Leo T: standing by. If telemetry clears within 10m we keep paused and resume with tighter probe.
Anna S: OK — pause confirmed, regional pin requested. Will update release notes with CI link and rollback rationale.
deploy-bot: Rollout r-20260323-01 is paused. AuditID a-5582 created.
Mike R: uploaded sample + short trace. 502s all include model shard mismatch in logs. forwarding to ML.
Jen P: thanks. :thumbsup:
Anna S: keeping this thread open until we either resume or roll back.
